# Browser dependency

`supabase-2.118.0.js` is the pinned Supabase JavaScript UMD browser distribution from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.118.0 . It is served locally to avoid blocking page initialization on third-party CDN availability. Preserve upstream code and notices. Update deliberately with browser/auth regression testing.
